title: Euro: Dollar strengthens against EUR after hot US PMIs – Danske Bank
summary: Danske Bank’s Danske Research Team notes that strong US PMIs and hawkish Federal Reserve pricing weighed on EUR/USD. The composite PMI rose sharply, driving expectations for another Fed rate hike in October and pulling EUR/USD below 1.14.

title: ECB's Kocher says must prevent too high inflation, becoming entrenched
summary: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member Martin Kocher said on Thursday that the central bank must prevent too high inflation from becoming entrenched.
